competences.description: Jumps into the air to attack all enemies, decreasing the target's Attack Speed for 2 turns with a 50% chance and stuns the target for 1 turn with a 30% chance. The chance increases by 10% and 5%, respectively, as the phase progresses.
Twists the body quickly to attack all enemies 2 times, each attack having a 50% chance to increase the chance of landing a Glancing Hit for 2 turns and to decrease the Attack Power for 2 turns.

Weakens the effect of dealing damage proportional to HP, and becomes immune to all harmful effects. Immunity is removed while in a groggy state. The damage taken from disadvantageous attribute Monsters increases by 50%, and the damage dealt to advantageous attribute Monsters increases by 50%. [Automatic effect]
King Slime has lost interest in the battle and is leaving the battlefield.
